title: Tabea Iseli: How hard can it be to create a non violent rogue lite dungeon crawler?
speaker: Tabea Iseli
talk_title: How hard can it be to create a non violent rogue lite dungeon crawler?
description:
This talk follows the journey of Grimoire Groves, a non-violent rogue-lite dungeon crawler. The talk explores which implications a non-violent concept has on game design, the stunning challenges of creating an audio-visual language for such a game, and why we even came up with such a concept. Be prepared for cute and colorful visuals, a quirky game, a lot of love for roguelite games, and tough game design questions.

Lead-in music generated by Sonat Uzun.
